task.goal: Commission this bottling line, then start production. Production (40 bottles) must ship at least 87 good bottles per minute, ship at most 0 underfilled bottles, reject at most 1 good bottles, and tip none.

params.rules:
You are commissioning a bottling line. Bottles are fed onto a conveyor, cross a checkweigher
platform (x = 2.0..2.4 m along the line, a load cell under a belt section), and a
pneumatic pusher at x = 3.6 m knocks flagged bottles off into a reject chute. The line is 5.0 m long.
Empty bottles weigh about 300 g (glass varies a little bottle to bottle); a full bottle holds
330 g of product. A bottle is DEFECTIVE if it holds less than 97% of nominal fill.
The checkweigher reports the gross weight. It flags a bottle when its reading is below `reject_below_g`.
The pusher fires when a flagged bottle is `pusher_offset_mm` before the pusher (encoder tracking), and
stays extended for `stroke_ms`. Bottle pitch on the belt = belt_speed * 60 / feed_per_min.
Everything else (belt grip, pusher speed and valve delay, load-cell noise, how many bottles are
underfilled and by how much) you must find out from test runs. Each test run costs line time
(sim_seconds). Lab audits tell you the true fill of every bottle in your most recent test run.
